evidence: Film thickness was measured using cross-sectional scanning electron microscopy (CS-SEM) and x-ray reflectometry (XRR). CS-SEM was performed on a LEO 1550 field-emission scanning electron microscope (FE-SEM; Oberkochen, Germany) using a 20 keV electron primary beam and a sample current of 50 nA. XRR was performed on ultrathin (<10 nm thick) samples using a Bruker D8 ADVANCE x-ray diffractometer (Karlsruhe, Germany).
